tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Latin fides, 'faith, trust', a Christian virtue name. Its root is Latin fides. A virtue name from the Christian theological virtue of faith (1 Corinthians 13:13). Faith is a Latin name meaning “Faith; trust; belief”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
